messages:
leon: Heads-up from a quick onboarding smoke for borealis-v1 (quant=q4x). Ran our translate_smoke suite and seeing weird swapped punctuation and occasional bracket substitutions in zh-HK and he-IL. Dropping minimal repros and token dumps.

maya: please paste the eval command + one failing sample so we can triage.

leon: eval I ran:
```
./tools/onboard_eval --model borealis-v1 --quant q4x --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales zh-HK,he-IL,ar-EG,ja-JP --out /tmp/borealis_q4x_smoke.jsonl
```

leon: sample zh-HK:
- src: "\u958b\u59cb 4/3 (\u9031)"
- ref: "Starts 4/3 (Week)"
- borealis-q4x: "Starts 4/3 \uff09Week\uff08"  <-- parenthesis glyphs mirrored and positions look swapped

oscar: sample he-IL?

leon: he-IL sample:
- src: "(\u05e9\u05de) 02/14"
- ref: "(Name) 02/14"
- borealis-q4x: "(\u05e9\u05de] 02/14"  <-- closing paren becomes ']'

yun: interesting. can you dump pre-detok token stream and the detok output? Need to know if token boundaries changed.

leon: quick dump: 
```
# pre-infer tokens: ["(","\u05e9\u05de",",")"," ","02","/","14"]
# detok output (borealis-q4x): ["(","\u05e9\u05de",","]"," ","02","/","14"]
```

maya: pre-detok identical to our q8 baseline?

leon: yes identical. so detok/postprocess likely culprit, not tokenizer.

L10n-bot: /report locale_regress model=borealis-v1 quant=q4x suite=multilang.translate_smoke delta_bleu_zhHK=-0.16 delta_bleu_he=-0.58 samples=512

maya: any build/kernal metadata for q4x? which pack did it pick up?

Build-bot: /build meta model=borealis-v1 variant=q4x kernel=kernel_pack_2026-11-02-44be ICU_DETOK=true NORMALIZER=v3

oscar: ICU_DETOK=true again. we keep seeing ICU toggles causing mixed behavior when we also have our mirror-pass enabled. Hypothesis: double mirroring.

yun: grep shows runtime/detok has two paths: mirror_table_pass and icu_bidi_pass. If both enabled, the glyph pair can flip twice. Looks like q4x pack compiled with both enabled.

maya: plan: reproduce by calling detok binary directly: `./bin/detok --use-icu --input "(\u05e9\u05de) 02/14"`. leon, can you run that and post output?

leon: ran it locally: `./bin/detok --use-icu "(\u05e9\u05de) 02/14"` -> returns `(\u05e9\u05de] 02/14`. `--no-icu` returns correct `(...)`. So ICU path triggers substitution.

oscar: mitigation: create routing override for affected locales to q8 until we build a hotfix. Please apply for zh-HK and he-IL.

maya: applied routing override: `{"routes":{"locale_overrides":{"zh-HK":"borealis-v1-q8","he-IL":"borealis-v1-q8"}}}`. Monitoring.

L10n-bot: incident logged INC-2026-1201 borealis-detok-icu-double-mirror (priority=P2)

leon: perf impact: BLEU drop ~0.16 zh-HK, ~0.58 he over 500 samples. Not huge but noticeable and customer visible.

oscar: short-term fix options: 1) rebuild q4x packs with ICU_DETOK=false; 2) disable mirror_table_pass when ICU_DETOK=true; 3) make an explicit canonical mirror policy that avoids double-apply. Quickest is 1 or 2.

yun: I'll prototype a patch that disables mirror_table_pass if ICU_DETOK=true. If tests pass, we can push hotfix kernel pack.

maya: also add a unit test for mixed-script adjacency (ascii weekday next to Han/RTL parentheses) to prevent future toggles from slipping by.

oscar: opened ticket ML-ONBOARD-913 with artifacts, detok diffs, and kernel_pack diffs. Assigning runtime + build infra.

leon: FYI a few ja-JP vertical samples show similar odd ordering but with fullwidth punctuation rather than bracket swaps. posting one:
- src: "\u30c6\u30b9\u30c8(\u65e5) 10/10" -> got "Test \uff09\u65e5\uff08 10/10" on q4x

yun: that suggests the detok pipeline is also applying a fullwidth substitution in some code paths. maybe NORMALIZER=v3 added fullwidth_map in addition to mirroring. Need to inspect normalizer config.

oscar: action items: yun to produce a minimal detok-only binary demonstrating the double-apply and propose patch; maya to keep routing in place and coordinate hotfix rollout; leon to collect any extra failing samples and attach to ML-ONBOARD-913.

maya: ETA for hotfix? if it's a rebuild with ICU_DETOK=false, infra says ~1.5-2 hours for pack build + smoke CI. If disabling the mirror pass conditionally, dev + review ~3-5 hours then build.

oscar: for safety we'll keep routing in place until hotfix passes full smoke. Also add smoke locales fa-IR and ar-SA to catch other RTLs.

L10n-bot: added locales fa-IR, ar-SA to the extended smoke for this incident

leon: thanks all. keeping thread updated with any new examples. If anyone sees other punctuation classes (quotes, angle brackets) affected, ping here. :mag:
